title: First At Least
constraints: 1 ≤ n, q ≤ 10^5; −10^9 ≤ a_i, x ≤ 10^9; a is sorted in non-decreasing order
hints: The array is sorted. What does comparing x with the middle element tell you about the other half?
If a[mid] ≥ x, the answer is mid or somewhere to its left; otherwise it is strictly to the right.
Keep a half-open range [lo, hi) and stop when lo == hi to avoid off-by-one errors.
